text:
john: Ferry at Pier 14 just announced canceled for weather. Anyone on the 8:30 Muni shuttle instead? My shoes are already a disaster. :umbrella:

maria: Heading out now — can grab a seat if there's room. where are you?

sam: Ugh. I was on the waitlist for the 8:05 ferry. Switching to #shuttle seems like the play. Anyone near Market & Embarcadero?

devon: I can swing by Market St. I have an extra pair of dry socks in my bag if anyone needs them. 

emily: @john I have a towel and a trash bag for soggy shoes (yes really). Also offered a spare umbrella to a commuter earlier, seagull tried to steal it. True story. :seagull:

john: @devon you’re a hero. I’ll meet you at the NW corner of Market & Embarcadero in 7. Thanks @emily for the towel offer LOL.

commute-bot: Caltrans alert: "Wind advisory in effect — ferries and high-profile vehicles may experience delays." https://status.bayferry.example/status

maria: Quick poll — who needs a seat on the shuttle? React with :one: if yes, :two: if standing ok.

sam: :one: (would prefer a seat, knee surgery is annoyingly selective)

devon: :two: I’ll stand, can carry @john’s soggy backpack.

emily: :one: definitely need to sit, also applying for honorary towel-lender of the year.

john: :one: seat please. Also reminder to folks: trains are packed, consider switching apps — I saw an empty ride-share leaving Mission.

maria: Anyone want to coordinate a meetpoint? I vote outside the Blue Bottle — fewer pigeons than the payphone area.

sam: Blue Bottle works. I’ll be there in 8. If someone is running late DM me and I’ll save you a seat.

john: All right rally point Blue Bottle outside table. If ferry comes back we pivot. Thanks team, see y’all (soggy but recoverable). :thumbsup:

emily: Also — if you see a seagull with a croissant reflexively surrender it, the seagull will respect you.

commute-bot: Reminder: shuttle capacity 20. Current shuttle ETA 11m.

maria: on my way.
